configuration_map: No geometric configuration exists. The proof works entirely with straight lines A, FG, and H as magnitudes, and numbers DE, EF, DF as ratio terms. No points are positioned in a plane, no angles are constructed, no circles are drawn, and no triangle interiors or exteriors are referenced. Unlike Heath's proof which uses a semicircle construction (semicircle AFB with F on it, applying III.31 and I.47), the AI proof defines H purely through the magnitude relation sq(A) = sq(FG) + sq(H) without any geometric construction.
skip_reason: The proof is purely algebraic/proportional with no geometric configuration claims. All reasoning operates on ratios of squares of straight lines and number-theoretic properties of the numerical ratio terms (whether DE, EF, DF are perfect squares). There are no point positions, ray orderings, angle decompositions, or inside/outside claims to check for spatial consistency.
